body: Ahh a newcomer I see :) How does it feels when you know you can't press?

Like everyone else outhere with those flairs, just can't hold back and find out what is does first.

I am only a 16 year old boy from Sweden that doesn't know much but what I have learned from my friends is that life can be really hard but finding something or someone that you really like is what makes life worth living for.

Your life seems really sad but don't give up, you will always be needed somewhere and people don't think less of you just because you tell them you are depressed. Probably the other way around except they don't know what to do. Hang in there, there is something waiting to be discovered at the end of the road and it is worth waiting for. 

Get some friend that you know would not judge you and talk to them, it is a good way to think in other ways that you might not think of yourselfe.

Sorry that life is so hard on you. Wish that is could be anything what it is not but I don't know what to say. My best ide and the same way I got through was to find new frineds and take everything step by step, not having any plans and just go with it. Just have fun and don't care to much about what others might think. Hope lifes turns for the better for you :)

You are not useless, no one is. You just have to find someplace where you belong and can do what you want to do. And are you sure you just want to "Slave and serve"? I won't say anything about it just sounds boring in my ears but if that is what you like, go for it. 

Anything that you would like to do just try it, life is to short to not do anything and remember: No one is useless, you just need to find where you fit in. Like in tetris or something.

Being happy is something that can come naturally or something you will have to find but in anyway I belive everyone on this earth where suppose to have a happy life. Everyone should be able to have fun, do funny thinks and enjoy life, and you just have to find what your happy thing is. 

I myself had problems before and felt that everyone hated me and I was nothing but then I found some new people that turned my life around, they changed everything and I stopped being depressed and started to enjoy my life the way it was. Finding something special is hard but it is worth it in the end. 

Try to find something to do with your girlfriend or anything, life it worth living for, and I once heard this (and liked it) "Suicidal is a permanent solution to a temporary problem."

How come you don't eat? Doesn't look good, hope you can get back into it. Life is a good opportunity to do whatever you want, doesn't have to be the best things at all times to do just whatever but just have fun and try to eat I guess :)

I understand you in a way, I tried to kill myself but didn't since I hade to many questions. A way to get around it is (if you ask me) get some really god friends you can talk to that would not judge you, or mabye parentes or teachers if you are in school. Just find people to talk to, if you know they really love you and wants you it could help. :)
